facts.fact: Minister Ibrahim Kalil Konaté, presenting the national digital development strategy (seven pillars) at VivaTech, claimed 5,207 km of fibre deployed by the State and a rural connectivity programme (PNCR) aiming to connect about 500 white-zone localities by end-2025; no report against the strategy's own targets is cited (Fraternité Matin, 13 June 2025).
